_comment: Budgets of the perf tests (StrataTests/src/Perf, suites Perf.* and PerfGPU.*; AGENTS.md, 'Testing').
Every metric a test checks (Perf::CheckBudget) or records (Perf::Record) needs an entry, or the test fails:
with a unit of "ms", "us", "MB" or "count". Lower is better: a test fails when it measures more than
Budget (express rates as cost per item). Measured is the metric on the reference machine (Intel Core i7-13700K,
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, Windows 11, Release build, ctest --preset windows-release -L perf on a quiet machine);
Budget is at most 1.5 times Measured (round down).
Ratchet: budgets only go down. A change that makes a metric cheaper measures it again and lowers Measured and
Budget in the same commit; a metric over its budget is a regression to fix, never a reason to raise the budget.
A commit that adds or lowers a budget states the measured values in its message.
